# unifi_device_statistics (Data Source)

Fetches the latest statistics for an adopted device via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). Read-only. Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Fetch the latest statistics for an adopted device (Official API).
data "unifi_device_statistics" "gateway" {
  device_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String) The UUID of the adopted device whose statistics to fetch.

### Optional

- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site to query. If not specified, the provider's default site is used.

### Read-Only

- `cpu_utilization_pct` (Number) CPU utilization percentage, if reported.
- `json` (String) The full statistics record, including per-radio interface statistics, serialized as a JSON string.
- `last_heartbeat_at` (String) When the last heartbeat was received, in RFC 3339 format.
- `load_average_15_min` (Number) 15-minute load average, if reported.
- `load_average_1_min` (Number) 1-minute load average, if reported.
- `load_average_5_min` (Number) 5-minute load average, if reported.
- `memory_utilization_pct` (Number) Memory utilization percentage, if reported.
- `next_heartbeat_at` (String) When the next heartbeat is expected, in RFC 3339 format.
- `uplink_rx_rate_bps` (Number) Uplink receive rate in bits per second, if reported.
- `uplink_tx_rate_bps` (Number) Uplink transmit rate in bits per second, if reported.
- `uptime_sec` (Number) Device uptime in seconds, if reported.
